title: Browser Use agent input
description: Run one bounded Browser Use agent in an isolated local Chromium session. The default extracts the first five Hacker News posts.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS page the agent should open before completing the extraction instruction.

task.title: Extraction instruction
task.description: Instruction whose result must fit the template's item schema: a list of titles and URLs. The number of items comes from "Maximum items".
task.default: Return the title and exact destination URL of the post-title hyperlinks on the page, starting from the top and preserving their displayed order. Each URL must be the complete absolute HTTP or HTTPS href attached to the title text, including its full path and query; never use a source-domain label, vote, comments, user, age, or navigation link.
task.prefill: Return the title and exact destination URL of the post-title hyperlinks on the page, starting from the top and preserving their displayed order. Each URL must be the complete absolute HTTP or HTTPS href attached to the title text, including its full path and query; never use a source-domain label, vote, comments, user, age, or navigation link.

modelName.title: OpenAI model
modelName.description: OpenAI model that drives the agent. Requires the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items the agent is asked to return, and of dataset rows kept from its result.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Every limit is enforced again in code when API callers bypass schema validation.

maxSteps.title: Maximum agent steps
maxSteps.description: Hard upper bound on autonomous Browser Use steps and LLM calls. On the last step the agent can only return its result, so keep the run deadline long enough to reach it.

deadlineSecs.title: Run deadline
deadlineSecs.description: Wall-clock deadline in seconds for browser initialization and agent execution.

actionDelaySecs.title: Delay between browser actions
actionDelaySecs.description: Minimum pacing delay between agent actions. The 0.5 second default limits top-level actions to at most two per second.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Route the isolated Chromium session through Apify Proxy. Disable it for direct local browsing.
